prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production pixel-art transparent full-body character sprite sheet for the existing Sheep Run touch game.
Input reference 1, white-sheet.png: identity and anatomy reference for the exact same cute sheep; preserve its oval scalloped cream wool body, small peach square face on the right, one visible dark oval eye, cocoa ear beside the face, four tiny cocoa hooves under the wool. Do not copy its outfit because it has none.
Input reference 2, sailor-v1-sheet.png: style and animation-composition reference, showing how a complete costume remains on this same sheep in all poses. Use the exact crisp limited-palette pixel-art look with chunky deliberate pixel clusters, dark cocoa pixel outline, soft cream highlight clusters; no antialias, smooth vector, 3D, or painted texture.
Primary request: create a NEW fully costumed sheep sprite sheet, complete individual finished costume on every frame. The sheep must unmistakably remain a sheep, never become a different animal or a Kirby-like round mascot. No arms, horns, hands, human legs, or long limbs.
Composition: landscape transparent canvas, EXACTLY 15 separate complete sheep sprites, in a regular 5 columns by 3 rows grid, uniform cells and character scale. Use the same orthographic side-view perspective. EVERY FRAME faces RIGHT, including fallen/dead frames. Each sprite has generous empty transparent margin inside its cell and clear transparent gaps from its neighbors; every hat/ear/backplate/tail/hoof stays completely inside its own cell. No decorative extras or detached objects.
Frame pose order by row:
Row 1: idle neutral; run 1 front legs forward and rear legs backward; run 2 legs tucked passing beneath body; run 3 forelegs back and rearlegs forward; run 4 feet spread wide in airborne stride.
Row 2: jump rising with bent tucked hooves; fall descending with hooves reaching down; hit recoiling and squinting still facing right; dash 1 stretched horizontal body with hooves swept backward; dead lying flattened on side facing right, eye closed.
Row 3: idle 2 gentle blink/breath and slight wool squash; run 5 high rear kick and one forehoof raised; run 6 landing contact with body compressed and forehooves ahead; dash 2 second horizontal dash pose with lower body and different hooves; dead settled flattened but different from first dead with slightly lowered head.
Motion requirement: all SIX running poses have visibly distinct hoof silhouettes and body positions. Do not duplicate any run frame. Idle 2 is distinct, two dashes distinct, two dead frames distinct. The costume is attached naturally to the wool/head and remains complete in every single frame.
Scene/backdrop: genuine alpha transparency everywhere outside the character, clean cutout edges; absolutely no opaque background, no checkerboard illustration, no ground shadow, no floor.
Text: NONE. No labels, lettering, captions, numbers, guides, grid lines, cell borders, dividers, watermark, or logo.
Subject costume: SAME CREAM SHEEP wearing a snug warm orange fox hood with exactly two compact pointed orange ears with small cream inner triangles. The hood frames but does not cover the small peach sheep face. Add small cream cheek trim around the hood opening, still preserve the real cocoa sheep ear where visible. Cream wool body stays visible, with a short attached orange fox costume tail with cream tip at the REAR LEFT of the body. Tail is a small sewn costume accessory, not a large animal tail. All four tiny cocoa sheep hooves remain clear. No fox muzzle, no fox replacement animal, no fox hands, no chest replacement, no orange-only animal body.
